mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_daily_task(task_key,task_date,elder_id,source_id,category,title,detail,target_path,due_at) VALUES(#{task.taskKey},#{task.taskDate},#{task.elderId},#{task.sourceId},#{task.category}, #{task.title},#{task.detail},#{task.targetPath},#{task.dueAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE category=IF(state='DONE',category,VALUES(category)), title=IF(state='DONE',title,VALUES(title)), detail=IF(state='DONE',detail,VALUES(detail)), revision=IF(state='DONE',revision,revision+1)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_daily_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id,s.name FROM staff s WHERE s.leave_flag='N' AND (s.role_id=#{adminRoleId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM elder_staff_assignment a WHERE a.staff_id=s.id AND a.elder_id=#{elderId} AND a.active='Y')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM role_auth ra JOIN auth au ON au.id=ra.auth_id WHERE ra.role_id=s.role_id AND au.url='/ai/daily/index') ORDER BY s.id
